market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Dow below key technical level, bond yields surging, and Iran conflict create 5-10% downside risk in equities over 1-3 months. Oil above $90 sustains inflation pressure. Yen intervention adds FX volatility. Selective tech buying (Citi call) offers tactical entries but broad market remains fragile. EM bonds and gold are relative outperformers.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle (Dell, PANW, GOOG) supports 6-12 month equity upside if geopolitical risk de-escalates. Healthcare M&A pipeline and value retail turnarounds provide sector rotation opportunities. Rising yields may normalize by Q1 2027 if oil stabilizes. Japan debt sustainability remains a structural overhang. Digital asset regulation (UK onchain, Singapore ban) creates 12-month regulatory arbitrage opportunities.
